import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, os
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10,"packet_limit":5,"prefix_width":2,"rules":[{"id":7,"class":2,"priority":10,"ranges":[[100,105],[-60,-60]]}],"fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
prog=json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN,'compile'],input=json.dumps(cfg),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True).stdout)
def run(lines):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p=os.path.join(d,'p.json'); open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(prog))
        proc=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN,'stream',p],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
        out,err=proc.communicate(lines)
        return proc.returncode,out,err
tests={
 "blank":"\n",
 "badjson":"{oops\n",
 "unknownop":json.dumps({"op":"foo"})+"\n",
 "unknownkey":json.dumps({"op":"tick","time":1,"x":2})+"\n",
 "decreasing":json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":5})+"\n"+json.dumps({"op":"tick","time":3})+"\n",
 "absentchunk":json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":9,"time":1,"source":0,"length":5}]})+"\n",
 "absentclose":json.dumps({"op":"close","flow":9,"time":1})+"\n",
 "dupop":json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1})+"\n"+json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1})+"\n",
 "restore_not_first":json.dumps({"op":"tick","time":1})+"\n"+json.dumps({"op":"restore","checkpoint":{"t":1,"fl":[]}})+"\n",
 "badsource":json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1})+"\n"+json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":2,"length":5}]})+"\n",
 "badlen":json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1})+"\n"+json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":0}]})+"\n",
 "partial_chunk":json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":1})+"\n"+json.dumps({"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":5},{"flow":9,"time":2,"source":0,"length":5}]})+"\n",
 "timetoofar":json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":1,"time":2**53})+"\n",
 "negflow":json.dumps({"op":"open","flow":-1,"time":1})+"\n",
}
for name,lines in tests.items():
    rc,out,err=run(lines)
    good = rc==2 and out.strip().endswith('{"error":"event"}')
    print(("OK " if good else "FAIL "),name,"rc",rc,"out",repr(out[-80:]))
PYEOF
